list.name: Maintenance Events
list.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "maintenance_event")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")

description: Phase 3 — Predictive Maintenance: Health Scores, RUL, Anomaly Detection, Tool Wear, Vibration FFT

panels.title: Component Health Scores
panels.description: Real-time health score (0-1) per machine component. Green ≥0.8, Yellow ≥0.6, Orange ≥0.4, Red <0.4

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "component_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "health_score")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["component_type"])

panels.title: Remaining Useful Life (RUL)
panels.description: Estimated remaining hours before component failure. Red <50h, Orange <200h, Yellow <500h, Green ≥500h

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "component_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "remaining_useful_life_hours")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["component_type"])

panels.title: RUL Timeline — All Components
panels.description: Remaining Useful Life trend over time. Downward slope = accelerating degradation.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "component_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "remaining_useful_life_hours")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["component_type"])

panels.title: Health Score Heatmap
panels.description: Component health scores over time as heatmap. Dark red = critical degradation.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "component_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "health_score")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["component_type"], valueColumn: "_value")

panels.title: Anomaly Scores — Isolation Forest
panels.description: Anomaly scores from Isolation Forest model. Values above threshold (red zone) indicate potential faults.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anomaly_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "isolation_forest_score")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["component_type"])

panels.title: Anomaly Events (Last 7 Days)
panels.description: Count of anomaly events per component per day.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "anomaly_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "is_anomaly")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_value"] == true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> group(columns: ["component_type"])

panels.title: Tool Wear Progression
panels.description: Estimated tool wear percentage. Threshold: Yellow >60%, Red >85% (schedule replacement).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "tool_wear")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "wear_percentage")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["tool_id"])

panels.title: Spindle Vibration FFT Spectrum
panels.description: Frequency spectrum of spindle vibration. Peaks at bearing fault frequencies (BPFO/BPFI/BSF/FTF) indicate incipient failure.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "vibration_fft")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "magnitude")
  |> group(columns: ["frequency_band"])
  |> last()

panels.title: Vibration RMS Trend
panels.description: Root Mean Square of vibration acceleration — primary indicator of overall machine condition.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "vibration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "acceleration_rms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Vibration Kurtosis
panels.description: Kurtosis of vibration signal — spikes indicate impulsive events (bearing defects, gear faults). Normal ~3, Warning >4, Critical >6.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "feature_vector")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "kurtosis")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Crest Factor & Shape Factor
panels.description: Crest Factor (peak/RMS) and Shape Factor (RMS/mean|x|) — complementary condition indicators.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "feature_vector")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "crest_factor" or r["_field"] == "shape_factor")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Active Maintenance Recommendations
panels.description: AI-generated maintenance recommendations with urgency levels, estimated downtime, and confidence scores.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "maintenance_recommendation")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "urgency" or r["_field"] == "action" or r["_field"] == "estimated_downtime_min" or r["_field"] == "confidence" or r["_field"] == "remaining_useful_life_hours")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "component_type"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["urgency"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)

panels.title: Bearing Fault Frequency Band Energy
panels.description: Energy in frequency bands around BPFO, BPFI, BSF, FTF and their harmonics. Rising energy = bearing degradation.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "bearing_band_energy")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "normalized_energy")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["band_label"])

panels.title: BPFO/BPFI Trend (Spindle Bearing)
panels.description: Trend of normalized band energy at BPFO and BPFI frequencies over time — early warning of outer/inner race defects.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "bearing_band_energy")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["machine_id"] == "${machine_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["band_label"] == "BPFO_1X" or r["band_label"] == "BPFI_1X")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "normalized_energy")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["band_label"])
